held_list.reason: Directly reported volumetric tensile toughness is supported and retained per cohort in context_measurements, but CPT work_of_rupture is J/kg. Without cohort density, no J/kg conversion is justified. This is a schema dimension limit, not rejection of the reported measurement.

No numerical cohort/test-linked fiber area, density, tex or final retained polymer/borate mass fraction recovered. SEM morphology, constituent nanofiber diameters, bath concentration and aluminum-foil thickness are not substitutes.
held_list.source_locator: Main pp.3-7; SI Methods pp.2-4, Figs S1/S3/S6/S7/S9/S13, Table S1; full main/SI geometry audit.

held_list.reason: SI Methods describes elongation at break but Table S5 does not tabulate it; no value digitized from representative curves or estimated as strength/modulus.

Main p.4 cites SI S3/S4 as CL-PIPD optimization. Printed tables label CSA/H3BO3-CNTFs and peak at 5.56 GPa, unlike CL-PIPD Table S5 6.36 GPa. No control is relabeled or admitted as one of these five states.
